llm_fields.description: It provides a loan of ₹25,000 and a subsidy of ₹25,000 to widowed, divorced or unmarried women from minority communities in Karnataka for economic activities.
llm_fields.eligibility: Female applicants who are widowed, divorced or unmarried, belong to a religious minority community, are permanent residents of Karnataka, aged 18 to 55 years, with annual family income below ₹3,50,000, whose family members are not government employees and who have not availed benefits under any other KMDCL scheme in the last 5 years.
